intro: Benin's economy rests on cotton, cashews and the port of Cotonou.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Benin is one of Africa's largest cotton producers. Cotonou's port handles goods for Niger and other landlocked neighbours, and much trade crosses the border with Nigeria.

chapters.title: Fruit
text: Sweet pineapples and cashews are growing exports.

keyTerms.meaning: Selling imported goods on to another country.

cardGroups.title: Made in Benin
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Benin makes and sells to the world.
